As a Client, I want to see audit reports shared with me for review, clearly distinguishing those requiring my action from those already reviewed, so that I never miss a pending review.
Given I navigate to /client/reports, when loaded, then I see filter tabs: Pending Review (with count badge if > 0) and All Reports.
Given I view the Pending Review tab, when items are present, then each card shows: audit name, report version badge, sent date, and 'Submit Feedback' primary button.
Given I view the All Reports tab, when rendered, then all reports (including reviewed and final) are shown with their status badges (Pending Review / Reviewed / Final).
Given I click 'Download Report' on any card, when initiated, then the DOCX is downloaded via GET /client/reports/:id/download.
Given a pending review report's feedback has already been submitted, when I view the card, then it shows 'View Feedback' instead of 'Submit Feedback' and the report is in Reviewed status.
As a Client, I want to provide structured feedback on each section of a draft audit report so that the Manager can address my concerns before the audit is closed.
Given I navigate to the report feedback form, when loaded, then a prominent download prompt card is shown at the top encouraging me to read the report before giving feedback.

Given I view the sections accordion, when rendered, then each standard report section (Executive Summary, Scope & Methodology, Findings by BU, Exception Summary, Recommendations) is shown as a collapsible item.
Given I expand a section, when rendered, then I see a status RadioGroup: Accepted ✓ / Requires Revision ✗ / No Comment (default) and a comment textarea.
Given I select 'Requires Revision' for a section, when rendered, then the comment textarea is highlighted with a required indicator.
Given I submit feedback with 'Requires Revision' selected but no comment, when validated, then the error 'Please describe what changes are needed for this section' is shown.
Given all sections are set to 'No Comment', when I click Submit All Feedback, then the error 'Please review at least one section before submitting feedback' is shown.
Given I click Submit All Feedback with at least one Accepted or Requires Revision section, when a confirmation dialog appears, then it shows: N sections accepted, N require revision.

Given I confirm, when the API responds with 201, then: feedback is saved; the Manager receives a 'client_feedback_received' notification; the audit status changes back to under_manager_review; a toast 'Feedback submitted. The manager has been notified.' is shown.
Given I have already submitted feedback, when I navigate back to the feedback form, then all inputs are shown read-only with submitted values and a 'Feedback submitted on [date]' banner.
As a Client, I want to be notified when my audit is formally closed so that I know the engagement is complete and the final report is available.
Given an audit is closed by the Manager, when the closure is processed, then I receive an in-app notification with type=audit_closed.
Given I click the audit_closed notification, when navigated, then I arrive at the audit detail page where a 'Closed' status badge and final DOCX download link are shown.
Given the audit is closed, when I view the Cockpit, then the audit card no longer appears in the Active Audits section and the Last Audit Closed KPI updates to show this audit's date.
As a Client, I want to filter all insight charts by a custom date range so that I can focus on a specific period for board presentations or reviews.
Given I view the insights dashboard, when rendered, then a DateRangePicker is shown at the top with preset options: 6 months, 1 year, 2 years, All time.
Given I select a custom date range, when applied, then all 5 insight sections refresh their data to include only audits with a start_date within the selected range.
Given I select a preset (e.g. '1 year'), when applied, then the date picker fields update to reflect the preset range and charts reload.
As a Client, I want to filter insights by specific Business Units so that department heads can see only data relevant to their area.
Given I view the BU filter multi-select, when rendered, then all my configured Business Units are listed as options.
Given I select one or more BUs, when the filter is applied, then all charts update to show only data for the selected BUs.
Given I clear all BU filters, when the filter is cleared, then all BUs are shown again.
As a Client, I want to see which audit findings appear in multiple audit cycles so that I can prioritise systemic issues for remediation.
Given I view the Recurring Findings section in Insights, when rendered, then items flagged in 2 or more audits are shown as a ranked list (most recurring first).
Given I click on a recurring finding item, when expanded, then the list of audits in which this finding appeared is shown with links to those audits.
Given no findings appear in more than one audit, when the section renders, then 'No recurring findings identified in the selected period.' is shown.
As a Client, I want to download the final audit report as a DOCX so that I can share it with internal stakeholders who don't have platform access.
Given an audit is closed, when I navigate to /client/reports, then the final report shows a 'Final' status badge and a Download Report button.
Given I click Download Report, when initiated, then the final DOCX is downloaded via GET /client/reports/:id/download.
Given the report is a draft (not final), when I view the card, then the download button is labelled 'Download Draft' with a muted badge to signal it is not the final version.
Multiple Users Under Same Client Entity

As a client organisation, I want multiple of our staff to be able to log in with separate credentials while all seeing the same audit data so that different stakeholders can access the platform independently.
Given two users are created with role=client and mapped to the same client entity, when both log in, then they see identical audit data, insights, and reports.
Given User A (client) submits feedback on a report, when User B (same client entity) views the report, then they see the submitted feedback with the submitter's name.
Given User A performs an action (e.g. responds to clarification), when User B views the thread, then the response shows User A's name as the respondent.
Client users of the same entity cannot see each other's login credentials or account settings.
View Open vs Closed Action Items
As a Client, I want to see how many audit action items are open vs closed and how long they have been open so that I can hold the right teams accountable for timely remediation.
Given I view the Open vs Closed Action Items section in Insights, when rendered, then a donut chart shows the ratio of open to closed items and an aging table shows open items with their age in days.
Given I hover over the donut chart, when hovered, then the tooltip shows the exact count and percentage for each segment.
Given I sort the aging table by 'Days Open' descending, when sorted, then the longest-outstanding items are shown first.
